svg.title: 01-peach-monkey
svg.desc: Vector paths traced from the matching original PNG. No raster images embedded. Palette approximates subtle source shading. viewBox trimmed to the ink (was 0 0 1254 1254) so the creature stands on the floor like the part-drawn ones. 2026-10-07에 밑에 남아 있던 1.25칸(viewBox 14.6)을 더 조였다 — 「닿는 줄」 검사가 그만큼 뜬 것을 잡았다.
